# MIST provenance

This directory vendors the locally used MIST implementation so that the
11-class experiment wrappers remain reproducible in this repository.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/Caisner/MIST
- Local source checkout: `/data15/data15_5/yuexin2/MIST`
- Local source revision at packaging time: `229f77c`
- The dataset folders, generated runs and binary checkpoints are intentionally
  excluded. Configure data and checkpoint paths through the experiment
  wrappers or environment variables.

Review the upstream license and citation requirements before redistributing
this vendored code.
